primary_purpose: Test whether carry-aligned speculative positions unwind around synchronized delivered easing
paper_claim_or_gate: Mechanism gate: a downstream public policy-rate event may coincide with an unwind of speculative long positions in high-carry currencies
required_interactions: public synchronized-easing proxy; documented currency crosswalk; lagged BIS policy-rate carry membership
merge_keys: assumed public release month; currency; contract code
timing_rule: Assume release three calendar days after report date and retain only the final assumed-available report in each month
target_outputs: CFTC position panel; public-proxy event-study figure; mechanism result ledger
keep_rule: Retained as directional downstream-proxy evidence because seven direct contracts can be matched; not promoted as confirmation because the conditional finite-rotation reference is coarse and imprecise
known_limitations: Sparse before September 1992; legacy categories are coarse; NOK and SEK absent; DEM/EUR is a documented proxy; historical release lag is assumed

primary_purpose: Separate a U.S. common term-premium component from expected-rate-path movements
paper_claim_or_gate: Alternative-explanation gate: synchronized inversions should not be only a common U.S. term-premium state

target_outputs: Expected-rate versus term-premium public-proxy diagnostic and event-study figure
keep_rule: Retained online: expected-rate component moves directionally while the 10-year term premium does not; family-adjusted inference is not decisive
known_limitations: U.S. Treasury 10-year model only; not a foreign-country 10Y-minus-2Y decomposition; current-vintage

primary_purpose: Measure delivered policy easing after signal onset; construct public policy-rate ranks; screen two- and three-country sensor combinations
paper_claim_or_gate: Mechanism gate: a growth-scare interpretation should predict subsequent easing or expected easing; exploratory gate: determine whether particular policy-rate combinations identify unusually weak shadow-carry episodes
required_interactions: BIS FX; CFTC; ACM; OECD G7 CLI; FRED controls; country-combination enumeration and maximum-|z| rotation reference
timing_rule: Define an onset only after three quiet months; carry ranks use the previous month's policy differential; target three currencies per side and include all cutoff ties with equal weight; combination onsets use the same delivered-easing rule and require at least six episodes in the baseline screen
target_outputs: Synchronized-easing episode ledger; public carry ranks; all public-proxy mechanism outputs; country-combination results, sensitivity tables, and finite-rotation references
keep_rule: Retained online as the event proxy, rank input, and exploratory sensor screen; explicitly downstream of and not a substitute for the unavailable IYC signal
known_limitations: Policy-rate concepts change historically and do not equal expected short rates; early observations can be representative rather than official target rates; combination screen is multiple-tested and sensitive to event-count thresholds; family interpretation requires simultaneous cyclic-shift exchangeability

primary_purpose: Build a public log spot-return proxy, verify quote direction, and score country-combination events
paper_claim_or_gate: Transparency gate: declared public inputs should permit an independently executable challenge of the sign and broad timing of currency losses; exploratory sensor-versus-risk-bearer check
required_interactions: lagged BIS policy-rate rank; synchronized-easing proxy; country-combination onset ledger
timing_rule: Normalize every downloaded series from local-currency-per-USD to the USD log return on foreign currency; rank with a one-month lag; target three currencies per side and include all cutoff ties equally; calculate the same cumulative months-0--1 proxy for every eligible pair and triple
target_outputs: Public currency panel; log spot-return event response; HAC and sensitivity diagnostics; common-rotation country-combination screen
keep_rule: Retained online as a spot-only association; no reconciliation or country-driver claim is made without the author panel
known_limitations: Not actual forward returns; spot leg omits interest income and costs; euro data are not a verified DEM splice before 1999; selected combinations can be crisis-sensitive

primary_purpose: Construct an independently sourced public 10Y-minus-3M synchronized-inversion proxy and audit its full rule neighborhood
paper_claim_or_gate: Nearby-measurement and specification-search audit: determine whether a transparent nearby yield-curve proxy predicts the public policy-ranked log spot-return proxy and whether the baseline-like rule is typical within the declared family
required_interactions: BIS bilateral FX rates; lagged BIS policy-rate carry ranks; deterministic fresh-entry/live-state recursion
timing_rule: Use current-vintage OECD monthly observations; splice Germany into the euro series through 1998 and the EA19 aggregate from 1999; build the month-t state from the 10-year government yield less the 3-month interbank rate; the one-month rule pairs it with a basket formed by t and returned in t+1, while the extra-lag rule re-sorts by t+1 and measures t+2
target_outputs: V0.3 proxy state ledger; specification curve; circular-shift reference; joint delete-one influence and geographically disjoint diagnostics
keep_rule: Retain in the main paper and online appendix regardless of sign because the complete declared family is a specification-search audit; do not promote as replication unless tenor, frequency, timing, and source match the absent author panel
known_limitations: This is 10Y-minus-3M rather than the paper's 10Y-minus-2Y baseline; the short leg is an interbank rate rather than a government bill; monthly current-vintage observations may be revised and are not end-of-month quotes; the Germany/EA19 splice changes geographic concept in 1999; Swiss and Japanese short-rate coverage begins late; public spot/rank outcomes are not forward excess returns
